Two Stories About Cops In Trouble Tell Us Much About Our Priorities

See
Drug Czar Returns To Party Line,
Opposes Including Ads Warning Kids About Alcohol
(Marijuananews note: These two stories were on Yahoo’s States News Service just as they appear here. The one who is far less dangerous is in far more trouble. Consider what this tells us about our priorities.)

June 9, 1999

Deputy Suspended for D-W-I - (INDIANAPOLIS) -- A Marion County sheriff’s deputy has been suspended for allegedly drinking then driving his patrol car. 17-year veteran Michael Hurd is charged with D-W-I and reckless driving. He’s suspended without pay pending an investigation.

Muncie Cop Busted for Growing Pot - (MUNCIE) -- State police arrested a Muncie police veteran for growing at least 100 marijuana plants in his home. Thirty-eight-year-old Gary Cox faces felony charges. The arrest came from a tip called in to police.
